preconditions.description: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 must be between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The number of vertexes in the graph must be between 2 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output graph must have exactly k shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2.

invariants.description: The graph must be undirected, meaning G_{ij} = G_{ji} for all i, j.
The graph must be simple, meaning G_{ii} = 'N' for all i and G_{ij} = 'N' if i = j.
There must be at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
